cds.title: University of Nebraska-Lincoln Common Data Set 2025-2026 (web edition, sections A-J)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set's residency split (in-state 9,229 / out-of-state 8,413 / international 1,006 applicants; international admit rate computed 530/1,006 = 52.7%, 64 enrolled), so international applicants are admitted less often than the overall 87.8%. Undergraduate enrollment and the international count are the 'Total Undergraduates' column (19,787; nonresident 457). No early decision or early action; no waitlist. Application closing date May 1 and priority date Nov. 1. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column; the Common Data Set reports whole percentages.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2027): SAT/ACT 'not required for admission, but consider if submitted'.

cost.notes: First-year rates for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set; the 'Non-resident (International)' tuition line is the one shown. Aid (final 2024-25): 120 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, averaging $10,391 ($1,246,965 total); the web edition does not show which aid types are ticked. Tuition varies by program (43% pay more than the listed tuition figure)
